units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 304">Yalk. Is. 304</cite> <he>זה העוֹצֵם עיניו כשעומדות וכ׳</he> he who closes his eyes when (he sees) Israelitish girls stand washing. Sifra K’dosh., Par. 3, ch. VII <he>יַעֲצוֹם</he>, v. infra.

senses.gloss: [to be compressed, hard,] to be strong, v. עָצוּם a. עֶצֶם.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:10">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> <he>שעָצַמְתָּ</he>, v. <cite ref="P01128"><he>עֶצֶם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Kiddushin 32b:11">Kidd. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>יכול יַעֲצִים עיניו וכ׳</he> perhaps a man might think, he will close his eyes and pretend not to see him (the old man); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 617">Yalk. Lev. 617</cite>; Sifra l. c. <he>יעצום</he>.

senses.gloss: to close (a dead body’s eyes), v. עָמַץ.

units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 31b:11">Snh. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>שנים שנִתְעַצְּמוּ בדין וכ׳</he> if both parties to a law-suit are stubborn, one saying, let us go to law here, and the other saying, let us go to the circuit court.

senses.gloss: v. עִיצּוּם 3) to fortify each other, i.e. to enter an agreement with the condition of forfeiture.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 1:16">Tosef. B. Mets. I, 16</cite> <he>שנים שנתעצמו זה בזה ואמר וכ׳</he> if two made an agreement wherein one said, if I do not come &c.
